Controls.label_about_details: Visit the TR2X GitHub page for further information.

enable_tr3_sidesteps.Title: Enhanced sidesteps
enable_tr3_sidesteps.Description: Enables TR3+ style sidesteps, e.g. shift+directional arrows. Dedicated sidestep buttons will still work.

enable_responsive_passport.Title: Enable more responsive passport
enable_responsive_passport.Description: Disables blocking user input when passport flips pages, scheduling the page flips instead.

enable_3d_pickups.Title: 3D pickups
enable_3d_pickups.Description: Enables 3D models to be rendered in place of the sprites for pickup items.

enable_cheats.Title: Cheats
enable_cheats.Description:
Enables various cheats:
- L: immediately end the level.
- I: give Lara all weapons; a boost of ammo and medipacks; and all plot items for the current level.
- O: enable DOZY cheat (swimming midair).
     - WALK key: exit DOZY.
     - GUN key: open the closest door (doesn't work in certain places).

enable_game_modes.Title: Enable game modes
enable_game_modes.Description:
Allows new game plus options to be selected from the new game passport menu.
- New Game+: unlocks all weapons with infinite ammo; enemies have double the HP.
- Japanese NG: weapons do double damage and flare pickups contain 8 rather than 6.
- Japanese NG+: combination of New Game+ and Japanese NG.

fix_m16_accuracy.Title: Fix M16 accuracy
fix_m16_accuracy.Description: Fixes the accuracy of the M16 while Lara is running.

fix_item_duplication_glitch.Title: Fix item duplication glitch
fix_item_duplication_glitch.Description: Fixes the ability to duplicate usage of key items in the inventory.

fix_qwop_glitch.Title: Fix QWOP glitch
fix_qwop_glitch.Description: Fixes Lara entering the QWOP animation.

fix_step_glitch.Title: Fix step glitch
fix_step_glitch.Description: Fixes Lara sometimes being pushed into walls adjacent to steps when running up them in a specific way.

fix_free_flare_glitch.Title: Fix free flare glitch
fix_free_flare_glitch.Description: Fixes the ability to spawn a free flare when pressing the flare input while picking up any item.

fix_pickup_drift_glitch.Title: Fix underwater pickup glitch
fix_pickup_drift_glitch.Description: Fixes Lara sometimes drifting when collecting underwater items, which can push her into walls.

fix_flare_throw_priority.Title: Fix flare throwing priority
fix_flare_throw_priority.Description: Fixes Lara prioritising throwing a spent flare while in mid-air, which can lead to being unable to grab ledges.

fix_walk_run_jump.Title: Fix walk-run-jump breaking
fix_walk_run_jump.Description: Fixes Lara at times not being able to jump immediately after going from her walking to running animation.

fix_bridge_collision.Title: Fix bridge collision
fix_bridge_collision.Description: Fixes Lara not being able to grab parts of some bridges and invisible walls at the edge. Also fixes collision issues with drawbridges, trapdoors, and bridges when stacked over each other, over slopes, and near the ground.

fix_glide_cameras.Title: Fix glide cameras
fix_glide_cameras.Description: Fixes glide cameras to respect the timer set in level triggers rather than defaulting the speed after the first frame.

fix_floor_data_issues.Title: Fix floor data issues
fix_floor_data_issues.Description: Fixes original issues with floor data/triggers.

fix_texture_issues.Title: Fix texture issues
fix_texture_issues.Description: Fixes original issues with missing or incorrect textures/meshes.

fix_item_rots.Title: Fix item rotation issues
fix_item_rots.Description: Fixes original issues with some incorrectly rotated pickups when using the 3D pickups option.

enable_auto_item_selection.Title: Key item pre-selection
enable_auto_item_selection.Description: When Lara presses action against a keyhole or puzzle slot, and she has the corresponding item in the inventory, that item will be pre-selected.

enable_gun_lighting.Title: Gun/explosion lighting
enable_gun_lighting.Description: Enables dynamic lighting to be generated for gunshots and explosions.

music_load_condition.Title: Load music track
music_load_condition.Description:
Loads the music track that was playing when the game was saved.
- Never: do not restore music tracks on load.
- Non-ambient: restore only non-ambient music tracks on load.
- Always: restore any kind of music track on load.

enable_lara_mic.Title: Microphone at Lara
enable_lara_mic.Description: Set the microphone to be at Lara's position. If disabled, the microphone will be at the camera's position.

underwater_music_mode.Title: Underwater music behavior
underwater_music_mode.Description:
Changes how music is played when the camera is underwater.
- Full: music plays normally while underwater.
- Quiet: music plays at half volume while underwater.
- Full but no ambient: music plays normally while underwater, but ambient music is muted.
- Quiet but no ambient: music plays at half volume while underwater, but ambient music is muted.
- None: no music plays while underwater (OG TR2).

healthbar_show_mode.Title: Healthbar behavior
healthbar_show_mode.Description:
Changes how the healthbar is displayed.
- Default: show the healthbar at the start of a level, after getting hit, or while having weapons equipped; flash the healthbar if it's already on screen when Lara's health is 20% or below (TombATI).
- Flashing or default: constantly flash the healthbar when Lara's health is 20% or below, or show under default circumstances.
- Flashing only: show the healthbar *only* when Lara's health is 20% or below (for challenge runs).
- Always: always show the healthbar.
- Never: never display the healthbar (for challenge runs).
- PS1: show the healthbar under default circumstances with no flashing.

healthbar_location.Title: Healthbar location
healthbar_location.Description: Location where the healthbar is displayed.

airbar_show_mode.Title: Airbar behavior
airbar_show_mode.Description:
Changes how the airbar is displayed.
- Default: show the airbar only in the water and flash the airbar when Lara's oxygen is 20% or below (TombATI).
- Flashing only: show the airbar *only* when Lara's oxygen is 20% or below (for challenge runs).
- Never: never display the airbar (for challenge runs).
- PS1: show the airbar under default circumstances with no flashing.

airbar_location.Title: Airbar location
airbar_location.Description: Location where the airbar is displayed.

enemy_healthbar_show_mode.Title: Show enemy healthbars
enemy_healthbar_show_mode.Description: Enables showing a healthbar for the active enemy.

enemy_healthbar_location.Title: Enemy healthbar location
enemy_healthbar_location.Description: Location where the enemy healthbar is displayed.

enable_fade_effects.Title: Fade effects
enable_fade_effects.Description: Enable fade transitions, for example between credit graphics.

enable_exit_fade_effects.Title: Exit fade effects
enable_exit_fade_effects.Description: Enables the fade effects when exiting the game to desktop.

fix_bear_ai.Title: Fix bear AI
fix_bear_ai.Description: Fixes the bear pat attack in The Golden Mask so it does not miss Lara.
